verdict.rationale: The only MCP evidence is a probe pointing to the Microsoft Learn training/support MCP page. That is a documentation-platform server for learn.microsoft.com, not an official MCP server that lets an agent work with Entra ID itself, so it counts as an adjacent host-platform capability and earns no credit. Nothing in the pack documents an Entra-specific MCP server or its tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
